name: s6-three-free-things
label: EXAMPLE · AI STAND-IN VOICE · NO FACE

lines.say: Three free things Microsoft gives you to learn Fabric. Save this.
One: a 60-day Fabric trial, a real capacity you can build on.
lines.tts: One: a sixty-day Fabric trial, a real capacity you can build on.

lines.say: No Copilot or data agents on the trial, but lakehouses, pipelines and Power BI are there to practice on.
lines.show: No Copilot or data agents. *Lakehouses, pipelines, Power BI:* yes.

lines.say: Two: the official practice assessment for the DP-700 exam, free on Microsoft Learn.
lines.tts: Two: the official practice assessment for the D P seven hundred exam, free on Microsoft Learn.

lines.say: Same style, wording and difficulty as the real questions, and it shows you where you're weak.
lines.show: Same style, wording, difficulty. Shows *where you're weak*.

lines.say: Three: the exam sandbox. You click through the real exam interface before exam day.
And the exam is 100 minutes, so practice with a timer.
lines.title: MINUTES
lines.tts: And the exam is a hundred minutes, so practice with a timer.

lines.say: Already certified? Renewing is free too: an online assessment on Microsoft Learn.
Save this, and send it to the friend who keeps saying they'll start Fabric next month.
lines.pre: and send it to a friend
